about_the_game:
Life of Delivery is an open-world courier simulator where you select orders from your tablet, pick up products from shops, load them onto your bike, and deliver them to customers.
Conversations at the doorstep may earn you extra tips, better ratings, reveal truths about their lives, or lead you into surprising events. Remember, while you are the main character, every customer you meet also has their own story.
Sometimes, their requests will depend on your choices—whether it’s asking your opinion on a bet, seeking advice on their relationships, or deciding what gift to send to a loved one.
Still, your primary duty is to deliver every order intact. If you damage goods through reckless driving or breaking traffic rules, you pay the price.
Your rating reflects how trustworthy you are. Higher ratings bring better and more valuable orders to your tablet. Careless couriers are rarely chosen.
Your motorbike is your true companion. Customize its color, wheels, plates, and stickers. Try out different bikes and enjoy the ride through the city.
Be mindful of traffic cameras at certain junctions. Speed may matter, but breaking the law can have consequences. (At least when the cameras are on!)
At night, you deserve rest like anyone else. Visit the bar, play Blackjack, or enjoy the city life. But nights can be dangerous—some people may ask you for deliveries that could bring trouble… or unexpected fortune.

name: Life of Delivery

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10+
  • Processor: i5 6500 / Ryzen 5 1600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GTX 1060 / AMD RX 6500 XT
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 25 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Onboard Stereo sound
  • Additional Notes: For texture loading to be smooth it is recommended to have at least 3GB of VRAM
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10+
  • Processor: i7 8700 / Ryzen 5 5600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia RTX 2070 / AMD RX 6600
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 25 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Onboard Stereo sound
  • Additional Notes: For texture loading to be smooth it is recommended to have at least 3GB of VRAM

short_description: Open-world delivery simulator where you bring orders to customers, upgrade vehicles, and encounter slice-of-life events. Meet people, help them, and enjoy unexpected conversations and opportunities on your journey.
supported_languages: English, Turkish, French, German, Simplified Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Russian, Swedish
